data.highlights: Extensive use of CSS line-clamping (`-webkit-line-clamp`) for track and album titles to maintain grid alignment, alongside standard underlines for interactive inline links.
insights: The typography system relies on Spotify's proprietary 'SpotifyMixUI' and 'SpotifyMixUITitle' typefaces, ensuring brand consistency while supporting extensive internationalization fallbacks.

Clear typographic hierarchy is established by reserving the 'Title' variant exclusively for primary display headings (24px+), while using the standard UI variant for both body and smaller headers (16px).
Font sizes utilize a CSS custom properties scale (`--encore-text-size-*`) mapped dynamically across breakpoints, establishing a responsive foundation for cross-device consistency.
